title: All Regional Director/Joint Director In-charge,
content:
P-11/12/MinistryMol&E/2024-RevII I/3364273/2025

No. P-11/12/MinistryMol&E/2024-RevII
Date: 11.12.2025
To,

All Regional Director/Joint Director In-charge,
Regional Office/Sub Regional Office,
ESI Corporation

Subject: New wage definition u/s 2(88) of ‘The Code on Social
Security, 2020’, implemented w.e.f. 21.11.2025.

Madam/ Sir,

The Code on Social Security, 2020 has been implemented with eect from
21st November, 2025. A new wages denition u/s 2(88) has been dened for
purpose under the Code including ESIC.

The new wage denition is dierent from the then wage denition u/s 2(22) of
the ESI Act, 1948. With implementation of the CoSS, 2020, a large no. of
exempted employees in a covered establishment is likely to be brought back/
covered under ESIC coverage with this new wage definition.

As such, eld units is advised to make awareness program in this regard and
ensure employer make compliance accordingly by covering all the employees as
per the new wage definition.

There are units where no. of contributing employees in EPFO is much more
than ESIC. Such unit may be identied and requested for compliance in respect of
employees, who may now fall under the ambit of ESIC.

This issues with the approval of the Director General.

Yours Faithfully

(Ashish Dixit)
Asstt. Director(Rev)
